_about: Translations orphaned by the 1F03/1F04 operand fix (2026-09-06).  Those opcodes were modelled as rel16 + 4 fixed u8, which equals rel16 + two condition terms + terminator -- right for the 562 two-term sites, wrong for the 353 with three or more.  Correcting it to rel16 + pairs_ff moved span boundaries in 282 records across 62 files.  extract re-homed 1,918 translations by content; these are the ones whose Japanese genuinely changed shape, so no unambiguous new home exists.  They are kept here to be re-attached by hand rather than silently dropped.
